items.question: In which year did the UAE declare the Year of Giving, announced in 2016 by the late Sheikh Khalifa?
items.fact: Year of Giving declared for 2017 by Sheikh Khalifa

items.question: Are non-Emirati residents eligible to apply to the UAE Debt Settlement Fund if their loans are in litigation?
items.gold: No, only Emiratis are eligible to apply.
items.fact: Debt Settlement Fund eligibility limited to Emiratis only
